g.text: Eight companies, and no two of them counting the same thing

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: the site's BY COMPANY tab — every company-level disclosure it holds, 28 points across 8 companies. Plotted

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: on a log axis: the site uses a linear one, on which the four smallest series lie flat against the baseline. No value is

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Tokens Per Day (tokensperday.com) — tokens_per_day_company.csv — chartData objects and evidence ledger as extracted

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows the Tokens Per Day published methodology and estimates pages

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: The series are not a partition of anything. Doubao's 180T/day sits inside the Chinese national aggregate, Microsoft's is Azure

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Foundry only with OpenAI-on-Azure counted under OpenAI, and Anthropic never disclosed a token figure at all — its line is inferred

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: from revenue. The record is thin: 2 of the 8 rest on a single observation, and the rest carry between 3 and 7 points over two and a

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: half years. These lines connect disclosures; they do not trace usage. Figures are dated to the midpoint of the period each disclosure

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: covers, and companies disclose on their own schedule, so two series at the same x are rarely the same week's news.
